depicted_variant: Fand and Lí Ban as two otherworldly seabirds flying joined by a gold chain; Fand dominates foreground.

visual_requirements.description: Fand in seabird form flying with Lí Ban, the two joined by one gold chain
Otherworldly flying bird manifestation, no invented beams
Sea background contextual to Fand as sea goddess

aura: Otherworldly seabird pair physically linked by gold chain c03 and commanding flight create reverent awe.
artistic_choices: Neutral white/grey seabirds with dark eyes and ordinary anatomical beaks are editorial species realization; no human body or clothing invented.
Foreground Fand versus smaller rear Lí Ban identifies primary subject editorially.
Wind and dark sea set motion without claiming an undocumented storm power. No attack on human shown.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Fand, the otherworldly Irish sea goddess in seabird form, flying with her sister Lí Ban joined by a gold chain.
ANATOMY: EXACTLY TWO living SEABIRDS with white and charcoal-grey feathering, each ONE head, TWO dark natural eyes, TWO wings, TWO tucked bird feet, ONE tail; Fand much closer and dominant, Lí Ban behind. ONE clearly visible physical GOLD CHAIN links their neck bases in a sweeping taut arc, no collar text [fand-c03]. No human heads or human arms.
MOMENT: Sweep forcefully low toward the viewer over dark sea, Fand's broad wings lifting in a forceful upstroke as the second bird banks behind; chain arcs diagonally through spray, real gold links readable. Fand looks down directly at viewer. Powerful decisive flight, not peaceful floating.
POWER: documented otherworldly seabird form and linked flight [fand-c03], no invented sea-control effects, glowing feathers or magic.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close angle just above sea surface; foreground Fand's head, spread wings and chain fill square; sister clearly separate behind, normal bird size through close framing, never a giant animal.
LIGHT & WEATHER: single sunset shaft on gold links and feather edges; deep warm walnut sea shadows, ordinary wind-driven spray.
SURFACE: layered real damp feathers, wet curved seabird beaks, heavy physical hammered gold chain, textured sea.
SETTING: open sea associated with Fand as sea goddess, background secondary [fand-c06].
MOOD: reverent awe, uncanny otherworldly linked flight; active and imposing, never cute, calm decorative birds.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons. Premium painterly brushwork, dark warm walnut and antique gold palette, square composition.
name: Fand
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native and 200px inspected: exactly two seabirds, separate one-headed/two-winged anatomies, joined by visible single gold chain between neck loops. Front Fand dominates in forceful flight with direct downward gaze, gold chain remains legible at 200px; real sea spray only. No human hybrid, glow, text or extra limbs. Seven Sangar checks pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px + 200px. Fand depicted in her otherworldly seabird form (c03): two seabirds swooping low over a stormy sunset sea (c06), each with one head, two eyes and two wings, joined by a single physical gold chain running between them — Fand large in the foreground with an intense gaze, Li Ban behind. The gold chain is the documented supernatural marker that separates this from an ordinary solitary gull; tight low action, no giant size or power beams, no text or aura.
